strictCompatibility.note: Strict comparison failures remain failures. This manual rollout review is not input to the strict compatibility gate.

checkpoints.decision: Reviewed recorder upgrade. The new phone-send and scenario-complete observations are real captured test controls. Old captures contain no invented checkpoints.

interactiveTurn_backgroundAgent_replySta.decision: Same complete automatic peer approval payload. Only its timing moved. All other actions remain ordered. Both captures replay successfully.

interactiveTurn_deleteConversation_remov.decision: The old run observed one push-token arrival and one registration request. The fresh short deletion run observed neither. No token delivery or push effect is asserted by this scenario. Each recording requires its own exact observed registration count. Strict comparison remains failed.

interactiveTurn_offlineRead_reconcilesPe.decision: Complete commands, ownership, recovery/history requests and connection lifecycle match. The old short pre-disconnect connection recorded two extra legacy backfill probes. One received the exact unsupported-type refusal and the next was cancelled by closing before a response. The fresh run issued neither in that connection. The original missed-page and chronological recovery assertions pass live and both replays. Each recording retains its own required probe payloads and counts. Strict comparison remains failed.

interactiveTurn_offscreenReply_survivesR.decision: Complete commands, history recovery requests and lifecycle match. Old capture has one extra model catalogue request on the restored phone connection. Its reply has exactly the same complete payload as the unsolicited same-conversation catalogue immediately before the request. Fresh capture receives the unsolicited catalogue and omits that redundant request. No mutation or recovered reply changes. Strict comparison remains failed.

interactiveTurn_reconnect_footerReadings.decision: Complete command payloads, action order, recovery/history queries and lifecycle match. The old restored phone connection made one extra catalogue request. Its correlated reply is identical to an unsolicited same-conversation catalogue in that connection. The fresh run gets its catalogue without that redundant request. Original settings/context/model-change or slash-command/compaction assertions pass live and both replays. Each recording still checks its own required query count. Strict comparison remains failed.

interactiveTurn_reconnect_slashCommandsA.decision: Complete command payloads, action order, recovery/history queries and lifecycle match. The old restored phone connection made one extra catalogue request. Its correlated reply is identical to an unsolicited same-conversation catalogue in that connection. The fresh run gets its catalogue without that redundant request. Original settings/context/model-change or slash-command/compaction assertions pass live and both replays. Each recording still checks its own required query count. Strict comparison remains failed.

interactiveTurn_rememberedEffort_recalle.decision: Complete action payloads, effort choices, settings/history queries and lifecycle match. Old capture received the real push-token input before the graph restart and registered it on the first connection. Fresh capture received that input only after restart and therefore registered it on the restored connection only. Each recording requires its own observed input ordering and registration count. The replay defect that moved the fresh token across the restart has a separate causal-prefix repair and focused regressions. Strict comparison remains failed.

interactiveTurn_saveAsChannel_promotesTo.decision: Complete promotion command payloads, action order, other queries and lifecycle match. The old short run observed no push-token input or registration. The fresh run observed one actual token arrival and its registration. This scenario asserts channel promotion and has no push-delivery obligation. Each recording retains its own exact input and registration count. Strict comparison remains failed.

limitations: The strict old-versus-fresh compatibility gate did not pass. Differences are reviewed explicitly before promoting the exact successful fresh captures.
Fresh recordings contain genuine phone-send and scenario-complete checkpoints absent from the older captures. No observations were added to old recordings.
Recorded payloads cannot prove real FCM delivery, encryption, transport recovery or real-time behaviour. The explicit live tests retain those obligations.
Capture test-package hashes identify the producing package before asset promotion. The separate final default-selection receipt identifies the package containing the promoted assets.
Per-case compatibility receipts retain their actual player revisions across repairs. The final normal-device receipt reruns all 71 shipped recordings together on one final build.
The final evidence document is added after the counted source revision. It changes documentation only.

One unchanged producer build captured all 71 scenarios. The subsequent player-only ordering repair has separate replay revision and package identities; it did not change the tested app or scenario assertions.
